messages.content: Tell me everything about the Enterprise plan.

Enterprise plan ($499/mo): unlimited storage, priority 24/7 support, custom domains, advanced analytics dashboard, team collaboration (up to 200 members), SSO/SAML integration, dedicated account manager, 99.99% SLA guarantee.
The Enterprise plan includes unlimited storage and priority 24/7 support.
